description: R30 完成率 harness 失效模式基准场景集：对齐 omp benchmaxxed 关注的编辑格式、读摘要与重试循环，新增 6 个 model-agnostic 客观场景（5 正 1 负），与 completion.json（F/N）及 completion_expanded.json（S1-S5）名字与内容均不重复。B1 用 hashline 锚点编辑修 bug；B2 跨文件一致性重命名（定义与调用点必须同改）；B3 先读大文件大纲再按行开窗精确定位并编辑，验证读摘要质量；B4 歧义 edit 必须被拒绝并回吐可读错误，模型据此改用唯一锚点重试而非盲改；B6 过期 hashline 锚点先报 stale 错误，重新读文件后用正确哈希重试；B5 负对照与 B2 同种子同 Check，但只改定义不改调用点，go test 编译失败退出 1。每个 Go 场景 Check 均 allow_exec + go test ./...(want_exit_code 0) + file_equals，逐字节锁死 *_test.go 种子内容防改测试作弊；Provider/Expect 写满脚本模式，live 跑批时由 liveSafeScenarios 归零脚本字段只留客观 Check。

scenarios.name: B1 hashline anchored edit (should pass)
scenarios.description: 正例（hashline 锚点编辑）：脚本先读 calc.go，再用 hashline=true 携带 anchor 与 anchor_hash 精确锚定 buggy 行并替换。Check 要求 go test ./... 退出 0，calc.go 逐字节等于修复后内容，并锁死 calc_test.go 种子。anchor_hash 是 sha256(anchor 字节) 的前 12 位十六进制，锚点正确时编辑落点唯一。
scenarios.prompt: read calc.go, fix Add using a hashline-anchored edit so the test passes, then report what you did

files.calc.go:
package calc

func Add(a, b int) int { return a - b }

respond.text: Fixed Add with a hashline-anchored edit; the test should pass now.

file_equals.calc.go:
package calc

func Add(a, b int) int { return a + b }

scenarios.name: B2 rename symbol across two files (should pass)
scenarios.description: 正例（多文件一致性改动）：定义处 Calulate 是拼写错误，测试与调用点都要求正确的 Calculate。脚本依次读并修 calc.go（定义）与 use.go（调用点）。Check 要求 go test ./... 退出 0，两个源文件逐字节等于修复后内容，并锁死 calc_test.go 种子。只改一处会留下未定义符号而编译失败。
scenarios.prompt: read calc.go and use.go, rename Calulate to Calculate in both the definition and the call site, then report what you did

files.calc.go:
package rename

func Calulate(a, b int) int { return a + b }
files.use.go:
package rename

func Total(a, b int) int { return Calulate(a, b) }

respond.text: Renamed Calulate to Calculate in both the definition and the call site.

file_equals.calc.go:
package rename

func Calculate(a, b int) int { return a + b }
file_equals.use.go:
package rename

func Total(a, b int) int { return Calculate(a, b) }

scenarios.name: B3 outline large file then precise edit (should pass)
scenarios.description: 正例（大文件定位后精确编辑，验证读摘要质量）：脚本先用 outline=true 读取 big.go 的紧凑符号目录，再以 line=12 开窗读取 buggy 函数周边，最后对唯一 buggy 行做精确编辑。Check 要求 go test ./... 退出 0，整份 big.go 逐字节等于修复后内容（证明编辑落在正确位置且未波及其它行），并锁死 big_test.go 种子。expect_request_contains 逐环验证大纲摘要与开窗结果确实回注上下文。
scenarios.prompt: outline big.go to locate the buggy function, read around it, fix Target so the test passes, then report what you did

respond.text: Located Target via the outline and fixed the buggy line; the test should pass.

scenarios.name: B4 ambiguous edit rejected then recovered (should pass)
scenarios.description: 正例（歧义 edit 被拒绝后按可读错误重试）：脚本先读 dup.go，再用出现两次的 old 尝试编辑；工具必须拒绝并回吐含 'appears 2 times' 的可读错误，文件保持不变。模型据此改用各自函数的唯一整行锚点分别修 First 与 Second。Check 要求 go test ./... 退出 0，dup.go 逐字节等于两处都修好的内容，并锁死 dup_test.go 种子。若歧义 edit 被盲改，只会命中一处，另一处仍错导致 go test 失败。
scenarios.prompt: read dup.go, fix both First and Second, using a unique anchor when an edit is ambiguous, then report what you did

arguments.old: func First(a, b int) int { return a - b }
arguments.new: func First(a, b int) int { return a + b }

arguments.old: func Second(a, b int) int { return a - b }
arguments.new: func Second(a, b int) int { return a + b }

respond.text: The ambiguous edit was rejected with a readable error; I retried with unique anchors and fixed both functions.

scenarios.name: B5 negative control partial rename (should fail)
scenarios.description: 负对照（应与 B2 同种子、同 Check）：脚本只读 calc.go 并改掉定义处的 Calulate，却不改 use.go 的调用点。Check 与 B2 完全一致（go test ./... want_exit_code 0 + 两个源文件全修复 + calc_test.go 锁死），因此 use.go 仍引用未定义的 Calulate，go test 编译失败退出 1，场景失败，证明完成率对跨文件部分修复不误判为完成。
scenarios.prompt: read calc.go, rename Calulate to Calculate in the definition only, then report what you did

files.calc.go:
package rename

func Calulate(a, b int) int { return a + b }
files.use.go:
package rename

func Total(a, b int) int { return Calulate(a, b) }

respond.text: Renamed the definition; left the call site unchanged.

file_equals.calc.go:
package rename

func Calculate(a, b int) int { return a + b }
file_equals.use.go:
package rename

func Total(a, b int) int { return Calculate(a, b) }

scenarios.name: B6 stale hashline anchor re-read then retry (should pass)
scenarios.description: 正例（重试循环：过期 hashline 锚点恢复）：脚本先用一个错误的 anchor_hash 发起 hashline 编辑，工具必须报含 'stale anchor' 的可读错误且文件不变；模型据此重新读文件，再用正确哈希（sha256(anchor) 前 12 位）重试。Check 要求 go test ./... 退出 0，stale.go 逐字节等于修复后内容，并锁死 stale_test.go 种子。
scenarios.prompt: read stale.go and fix Scale using a hashline anchor with the correct hash so the test passes, then report what you did

files.stale.go:
package stale

func Scale(x int) int { return x + 2 }

respond.text: The stale anchor was rejected; I re-read the file and retried with the correct hash to fix Scale.

file_equals.stale.go:
package stale

func Scale(x int) int { return x * 2 }
